info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of rideshare drivers available within the platform. This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about each driver, including their availability, rating, and the rides they have completed. Typically utilized by rideshare applications and driver management systems, this API supports real-time monitoring and optimization of driver resources. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve rides assigned to a specific driver
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all rides that are currently assigned to a specified driver, providing insights into their ongoing and completed trips. Use this to monitor driver activity and performance.
